text:
anne: Quick check — where's the canonical place to look for TTFT (p50/p95/p99) and tokens/sec dashboards? I need links for a PR and an on-call handoff.

mike: Start with Grafana -> Observability / Latency folder. The specific panels I use: 
- "API TTFT p50/p95/p99 (route)"
- "Tokens/sec by model"
- "TTFT heatmap (slice by customer tier)"
Links (bookmarks): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/obs-latency/observability-latency?orgId=1

priya: Also the quick shortcut: open the dashboard and press "p" to search panels, type "TTFT". Saves time. :thumbsup:

jordan: For Prometheus queries, grab p95 with something like:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Tokens/sec (rough):
```
sum by (model) (rate(redwood_tokens_emitted_total[1m]))
```
Those are what the panels use (with a few labels filtered).

sam: If you're triaging a slow trace, open Jaeger from the same dash (top-right link "Open trace"). Look for long tail KV cache misses. Example filter: 
- service: inference-runtime
- span tag: kv_cache_miss=true

anne: Perfect. Any recommended alert thresholds? We keep getting noisy p95 alerts for small slices.

mike: We recently adjusted the p95 alert in the "latency-slo-rules" group. Current sane defaults:
- p50: informational
- p95: warn at 250ms for small routes, 500ms for heavy models
- p99: page at 1s+ for customer-tier=prod
Alert rule snippet name: `alert: TTFTP95High`

priya: To reduce noise, try using the `increase(...[5m])` or require the p95 to be > threshold for 3/5 minutes and add `for: 10m` in the alert. We also have a composite that suppresses non-prod.

anne: How do I slice to a single route/model in the dash?

mike: Click the route filter at top of the dashboard, or use the URL params, e.g.: `?var-route=/v1/generate&var-model=redwood-medium` — that way panels only show that slice and alerts evaluate the same.

jordan: For correlating logs, Kibana query I use: `request_id: <id>` and then add `log.level:ERROR` and `latency.ms:>500`. That surfaces backend stalls.

sam: FYI obs-bot posts a pinned summary each morning in #eng-oncall with links. If you want, I can add the PR link and the dashboards to the daily note.

obs-bot: Daily obs summary posted: https://notes.redwood.internal/daily/obs-anchors — contains canonical panels and the runbook link.

anne: Awesome, thanks all. I'll drop the PR link and the slice params in the on-call note and tag reviewers.

mike: One last tip — for token-rate sanity, check `tokens/sec` against `requests/sec * avg_tokens_per_request` in the token economics panel. If tokens/sec >> expected, it usually means a prompt explosion or a bad system message.

priya: And if you want a reproducible dashboard bookmark, open the panel, click share -> snapshot, and paste that snapshot in the PR. Saves reviewers time. :white_check_mark:

anne: Done. PR description now has: dashboard links, snapshot, route/model params, and the two PromQL snippets. Thanks!
